title: Coordinador(a) Jr. de E-commerce — Amazon & Mercado Libre
description:
About the job

Coordinador(a) Jr. de E-commerce — Amazon & Mercado Libre




📍 Zapopan / Guadalajara, Jalisco 




¿Te gustaría ver en tiempo real cómo tus decisiones impactan ventas reales? Operamos varias marcas propias dentro de Amazon y Mercado Libre, y buscamos sumar a alguien que quiera aprender el negocio desde adentro — no solo ejecutar tareas, sino entender por qué las cosas funcionan (o no) dentro de un marketplace.




Aquí las ideas se escuchan de verdad, y tu trabajo tiene impacto directo desde el primer día.




¿Qué vas a hacer?

Te vas a involucrar en catálogo, campañas, inventarios y análisis de resultados de productos que la gente compra todos los días. También vas a participar en pensar qué estrategias probar y qué productos lanzar para hacer crecer las cuentas.




¿Para quién es esto?

Para alguien que estudia o estudió Comercio y Negocios Digitales, Mercadotecnia, Administración o carreras afines. Lo que más valoramos es el interés genuino en el e-commerce — no que sea "cualquier trabajo". Si además ya tienes algo de conocimiento básico o intermedio en e-commerce o marketplaces, suma bastante. Buscamos a alguien con ganas de resolver problemas y aprender rápido.




Lo que puedes esperar:

Formación práctica desde el primer día y participación en proyectos reales. Quien entra con actitud, en pocos meses ya está manejando responsabilidades con autonomía real — y si el fit es bueno de ambos lados, buscamos que ese crecimiento se traduzca en algo más permanente dentro del equipo.




¿Te interesa? Envíanos tu CV y cuéntanos qué te llama la atención del e-commerce. También puedes compartir esta vacante con alguien que consideres que puede encajar.




#Ecommerce #Amazon #MercadoLibre #Empleo #Guadalajara

title: IA & Digital Acquisition Specialist
description:
About the job

ÚNETE AL EQUIPO MIDOT LATAM




MIDOT es una compañía multinacional especializada en evaluaciones de integridad, estabilidad laboral, seguridad y conductas contraproducentes en el trabajo. Tenemos más de 40 años de experiencia en investigación y desarrollo continuo, ofreciendo herramientas confiables y validadas científicamente para la toma de decisiones en contratación, promoción y gestión de talento.




Buscamos un/a IA & Digital Acquisition Specialist responsable de planear, ejecutar, optimizar y medir campañas digitales de adquisición enfocadas en generación de leads calificados y oportunidades comerciales utilizando diferentes herramientas de IA.




La persona será responsable principalmente del manejo de campañas pagadas en LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads —Facebook/Instagram— y Google Ads, asegurando que la inversión digital se traduzca en tráfico de calidad, leads relevantes, citas comerciales y oportunidades para el equipo de ventas.

Este rol es clave para fortalecer la estrategia de adquisición digital, mejorar la eficiencia del funnel y escalar los canales de paid media con foco en performance, conversión y calidad de leads.




¿Qué harás en el puesto?

• Liderar la ejecución táctica y optimización de campañas digitales pagadas para generación de demanda.

• Asegurar que las campañas digitales contribuyan al cumplimiento de objetivos comerciales: leads calificados, citas, oportunidades y clientes.

• Administrar el presupuesto asignado a medios digitales, priorizando eficiencia, conversión y calidad del lead.

• Trabajar de forma coordinada con marketing, ventas, diseño, contenido y operaciones comerciales.

• Dar seguimiento al desempeño del funnel digital, desde la campaña hasta el CRM.

• Proponer mejoras constantes en audiencias, mensajes, creatividades, landings, formularios y journeys de conversión.

• Detectar oportunidades de crecimiento por canal, país, producto, industria y buyer persona.

• Presentar resultados, insights y recomendaciones accionables para mejorar el performance de adquisición.

• Mantener actualizadas las mejores prácticas de paid media, adquisición digital, automatización, tracking y performance B2B.




¿Qué conocimientos debes de tener?

- Paid media & Performance

-Google Ads & SEM

-LinkedIn Ads

-Meta Ads

-Funnel, CRM & Sales Alignment

-Analytics & Reporting

-SEO, AEO & Digital Acquisition




Experiencia que necesitamos de ti:

+ de 4 años en campañas B2B, SaaS, HR Tech, consultoría, tecnología o servicios profesionales. Performance Marketing, Paid media, Digital Acquisition o growth marketing. Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads.

Conocimientos sólidos de funnels de adquisición, generación de leads y optimización de conversiones. CRM, GA4, Google Tag Manager y Looker Studio.

Experiencia optimizando landings, formularios y jouneys digitales. 

Capacidad analítica para interpretar datos y convertirlos en recomendaciones accionables.




Paqueterías que debes dominar:

Google Ads

 -Meta Business Manager

-LinkedIn Campaign Manager

-Google Analytics 4

-Google Tag Manager

-Looker Studio

- Google Search Console

-Pipedrive o CRM similar

-Excel / Google Sheets

- SEMrush, Ahrefs, Ubersuggest o herramientas similares de keywords y SEO

-Doppler o herramientas de automatización/email marketing

-Canva, Figma o herramientas básicas para revisión de creatividades

-ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity u otras herramientas de AI para research, análisis, reporting y optimización de campañas




Escolaridad: Licenciatura en Marketing, Publicidad o afin.




Idiomas: inglés avanzado




¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Trabajo Híbrido, ambiente flexible,

Sueldo bruto $35,000 + prestaciones superiores a la ley

Horario: 09:00 a 18:00 hrs. de lunes a viernes

description:
About the job

I’m helping System Blue Solutions find a top candidate to join their team flexible for the role of Lead Generation Specialist - Commission Based.




You will drive business growth by independently managing high-impact lead generation cycles.




Compensation:

Unpaid




Location:

Remote (anywhere)




Mission of System Blue Solutions:

"We know firsthand how overwhelming it can be to juggle strategic responsibilities while handling tasks that could be delegated to the right support professional. That's why we developed a streamlined process for sourcing, vetting, training, and matching exceptional offshore Virtual Assistants and Executive Assistants to the specific needs of each client."




What makes you a strong candidate:

You are proficient in Sales outreach, Sales, Prospecting, Network, Lead qualification.
English - Conversational




Responsibilities and more:

We're looking for a Lead Generation Specialist who thrives on autonomy, hustle, and getting paid for outcomes — not attendance.




This is a 100% commission-based, recurring-pay position. There is no hourly rate, no salary, and no guaranteed income. You earn when you generate results. If that excites you rather than scares you, keep reading.




What You'll Do:

- Proactively source, qualify, and generate new sales leads through your own channels, network, and prospecting methods.

- Optionally hand off qualified leads to our sales team for closing, or run the full cycle yourself (prospect → pitch → close) if you have the skill set.

- Maintain accurate, real-time tracking of every lead you generate so commissions are correctly attributed.

- Operate independently, using your own tools, systems, and outreach strategy.

- Sign and honor a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) to protect company and client information.




Compensation Structure (Recurring Commission)

This role is commission-only — there is no hourly, salary, or retainer pay of any kind.

- You source the lead, our sales rep closes the deal 5% recurring commission

- You source the lead AND close the deal yourself 10% recurring commission

Commissions are recurring, paid monthly, for as long as the client stays active.




Tools & Equipment

- You must supply your own laptop/computer, internet connection, phone/dialer, and any CRM, prospecting, or outreach tools you use.

- The company does not provide equipment, software licenses, or tool stipends for this role.




This role is built for self-starters who are willing to bet on themselves.

You'll thrive here if you:

- Are genuinely energized by uncapped, performance-based earning potential — not just tolerating it.

- Have (or can build) your own lead sources, network, or prospecting system from day one.

- Are disciplined enough to manage your own schedule, pipeline, and outreach without supervision.

- Treat this like running your own micro-business, not "a job."

- Are comfortable with income variability in exchange for unlimited upside.




To be direct: this is not the role for someone looking for stability, a predictable paycheck, or a traditional 9-to-5 job.




Your potential leader(s):

Vaxy Valmyr - Salesforce Specialist | NPSP | Apsona | IModules at Philadelphia College of Osteopathic Medicine



Desired Skills and Experience

Sales outreach, Sales, Prospecting, Network, Lead qualification, Lead generation, Cold outreach, CRM

description:
About the job

As the Social Media Specialist, you will be responsible for helping with Emerson’s Test and Measurement Business group social media channels. Together with the Chief of Social Media, you will develop and implement an overall social media strategy that supports T&M’s customer-centric marketing strategy and aligns with the business Group’s brand identity. This role requires close coordination with multiple marketing teams to integrate a social media strategy that supports our customers and industry needs.




This role requires a strong understanding of the global social media landscape to effectively drive day-to-day tactical execution of campaigns and meet company expectations.




In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

Collaborate with internal teams to translate marketing objectives into social strategies.
Execute strategic social campaign planning for individual marketing campaigns and projects.
Develop an organic content strategy and handles the editorial calendar including the scheduling via Khoros Marketing, HootSuite, or any similar scheduling platform.
Copywriting, Generate creative assets (Using tools such as Canva/Adobe), and manage related processes.
Daily use of social media channels for reporting, analytics, and trend tools (including but not limited to: HootSuite, Adobe Analytics, Khoros, Trello, etc).
Moderate and respond to all social media engagement (replies, comments, messages) with an excellent customer service attitude.
Test, optimize, and report global campaign results on an ongoing basis across multiple social media channels and present to internal stakeholders.
Proactively identify campaign issues and formulate actionable solutions based off findings.
Understand the company’s business objectives to effectively translate them into social media campaign goals and strategies.
Monitor social media trends, best practices and techniques to ensure correct account spend/growth, identify new opportunities and optimize user experience through analytics and A/B testing.
Clearly communicate work status, potential issues, and successes with team, internal stakeholders, and external agency.




Who You Are:

You build strong, effective teams by bringing together diverse perspectives and working collaboratively toward shared outcomes. You communicate clearly and consistently, adapting your messaging for different audiences and channels. You place a high priority on customer needs and act with a service mindset to deliver value and positive experiences. You plan and align your work with organizational priorities, managing multiple responsibilities while maintaining focus, adaptability, and attention to detail.




For This Role, You Will Need:

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
3 to 5 years of experience supporting or managing social media accounts for a brand or organization, preferably within the B2B technology industry.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages across formats and audiences.
Advanced level of English.
Hands-on experience managing social media platforms through tools such as Khoros and/or Hootsuite.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with major social media platforms such as LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and X.
Comfort learning and using digital tools, platforms, and analytics systems.
Demonstrated ability to interpret data and apply insights to improve performance.
A collaborative approach and the ability to build positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.




Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:

Experience creating and managing B2B social media content.
Exposure to global or multinational environments and cross-regional campaigns.
Strong analytical skills with a passion for data-driven decision-making.
Experience presenting insights and recommendations to stakeholders.
Self-motivation, curiosity, and resourcefulness in problem-solving and innovation.




Our Culture & Commitment to You:

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, vacation and holiday leave.

About the job

Affiliate & Influencer Marketing Specialist

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (flexible, we care about results, not clocks) | Fluent English required




Salary Range: $900 to $1,500 USD per month plus performance bonuses, based on experience.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a fast-growing, women-owned DTC eyewear brand known for innovative, problem-solving sunglasses and bold product design. Our slogan, “sunglasses with a solution,” reflects our focus on function, style, and constant improvement. We’ve built a global customer base and a highly engaged social community of over 250,000 followers, driven by founder-led storytelling, product innovation, and performance-driven content.




We operate as a lean, high-performance team where speed, ownership, and results are the standard. We move fast, test constantly, and prioritize revenue impact over surface-level activity.




The Role

We're looking for a strategic, highly organized, and relationship-driven Affiliate & Influencer Marketing Specialist to help grow one of TopFoxx's most important revenue channels.




Success in this role isn't determined by how many influencers you recruit, it's measured by your ability to build strong relationships, activate creators, generate consistent content, and drive profitable revenue.




While experience in influencer or affiliate marketing is valuable, we're equally interested in candidates with exceptional communication, persuasion, and marketing skills who are eager to learn. If you're naturally proactive, enjoy building relationships, think strategically, and know how to motivate people, we want to hear from you.




This role requires someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, takes ownership, builds themselves to be the expert in their field and enjoys improving systems while delivering measurable business results.




Core Responsibilities




1) Affiliate Recruitment & Relationship Management

Build and scale a large affiliate creator network across TikTok, Instagram, LTK, and other relevant platforms.
Recruit, onboard, and develop creators with the goal of building a network of 5,000+ affiliates.
Build meaningful relationships with creators through personalized outreach and ongoing communication.
Develop long-term partnerships that encourage consistent posting and repeat collaboration.
Keep creators engaged by providing timely support, product recommendations, campaign updates, and performance feedback.
Re-engage inactive affiliates and maintain a healthy, active creator pipeline.




2) Affiliate Growth & Performance

Build and grow a high-performing affiliate network focused on consistent revenue generation rather than vanity metrics.
Monitor affiliate activity, posting frequency, conversions, and overall performance.
Identify top-performing creators and develop strategies to scale their success.
Analyze underperforming partnerships and make recommendations to improve results or discontinue collaborations.
Continuously optimize commission structures, gifting strategies, incentives, and creator engagement to maximize ROI.




3) Campaign & Program Management

Coordinate gifting campaigns, product launches, seasonal promotions, and creator initiatives.
Support TikTok Live scheduling and collaboration opportunities with affiliates.
Ensure creators receive accurate information, products, tracking, and campaign materials.
Maintain organized workflows and ensure campaigns are executed on time.




4) Data, Reporting & Optimization

Maintain accurate CRM records, affiliate databases, and outreach tracking.
Monitor key performance indicators including revenue, GMV, conversion rate, posting activity, ROI, and affiliate retention.
Prepare clear reports identifying trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Use data to recommend new strategies, improve efficiency, and support profitable program growth.




5) Systems & Continuous Improvement

Develop SOPs, templates, and scalable processes that improve efficiency.
Stay informed on creator trends, platform updates, and emerging marketing opportunities.
Test new outreach strategies, partnership ideas, and growth initiatives.
Support additional marketing and growth projects as business needs evolve.




Requirements & Experience

Required

Excellent written and spoken English.
Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills.
Strong persuasion and negotiation abilities.
Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.
Strategic marketing mindset with a focus on measurable business results.
Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret performance data.
Ability to manage multiple projects and conversations simultaneously.
Self-motivated with the ability to work independently.
Comfortable learning new platforms, tools, and systems quickly.
Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and initiative.

Preferred

Experience in Influencer Marketing, Affiliate Marketing, Partnership Marketing, or related marketing roles.
Experience working with creators, influencers, or online communities.
Familiarity with eCommerce platforms.
Experience building workflows, SOPs, or scalable marketing processes.
Understanding of digital marketing, consumer behavior, and conversion optimization.




Who You Are

Entrepreneurial: You spot opportunities others miss and act on them, solving problems without waiting for direction
Growth-Obsessed: You want to be the best in your field, not just good at the job, so you teach yourself relentlessly and treat becoming the go-to expert as a personal standard
Competitive Greatness: You're driven to be the best and you bring your A-game when it matters most, especially under pressure
Analytical: You think in ROI, margins, and performance, not vanity metrics
Persuasive: You understand creator psychology and know how to motivate consistent posting and sales
Creative Differentiator: You know the market is oversaturated, so you find creative ways to cut through: your communication style, the genuine care you bring to your creators and the product, and how thoughtfully you present and place it
Execution-Focused: You can manage high volume without losing structure or quality
Professional: You're the face of TopFoxx to every creator you touch, so you communicate with polish, follow through on what you promise, and represent the brand with care
Ownership Mentality: You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks




Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience with performance bonuses
Performance-based bonuses tied to results
Fully remote work
PTO + paid holidays
Free TopFoxx products
Clear path to a leadership role




While experience in Influencer Marketing or Affiliate Marketing is valuable, it is not the only path to success in this role. We are looking for someone with exceptional communication skills, strong marketing judgment, and the ability to build relationships and persuade people. The right person may come from influencer marketing, partnerships, sales, community management, brand marketing, or another field where communication and strategic thinking drive results.




This is a high-ownership, performance-driven role. You will be responsible for building a real revenue engine, not managing surface-level influencer activity. If you are motivated by growth, ownership, and measurable impact and know how to build profitable affiliate systems, we want to meet you!




Don't see the perfect fit? If you believe you'd be a great addition to TopFoxx but this role isn't the best match, we'd still love to hear from you. Please email your resume and a brief introduction to recruiting@topfoxx.com and let us know which role(s) you're interested in. We're always excited to connect with exceptional talent.

description:
About the job

Remote SaaS Sales Representative — BowerBird.io


Location: Remote — Mexico (or other South American countries)




Please note: You must have C2 or native-speaker-level written and spoken English. Please do not apply unless your English is at this level.




About BowerBird




BowerBird is an Australian online platform that connects architecture and design professionals with journalists so they can get their work published.




We are a fully remote, global team that values excellent work, direct feedback and daily improvement. We work with architects, designers and media professionals around the world, including people from many of the largest and most respected design publications.


About the role




We are looking for an experienced Sales Closer to help architects and designers decide whether BowerBird is right for them.




Your main responsibility will be conducting pre-booked sales meetings via Zoom with prospects who have already expressed an interest in BowerBird.




You will uncover what each prospect wants to achieve, understand what is preventing them from achieving it and show how BowerBird could support their business goals. You will present the platform, recommend the right plan, discuss pricing, handle concerns and ask directly for the sale.




You will also regularly call inbound leads who have engaged with BowerBird but have not yet booked a meeting. These are not random cold calls: they are people who have already shown an interest in what we do. Your job will be to understand why they became interested, determine whether there is a genuine opportunity and book an appropriate sales meeting.




Phone calls are part of this position, alongside email and other follow-up methods. You should be comfortable picking up the phone when it is the most effective way to start a conversation or move a lead forward.


What you will do




Conduct pre-booked sales meetings with architects, interior designers and other design professionals.
Call inbound leads and convert suitable prospects into booked meetings.
Research prospects before each meeting.
Use needs-based discovery to understand each prospect’s business goals and challenges.
Connect BowerBird’s features to specific outcomes rather than delivering a generic demonstration.
Recommend the most suitable subscription plan.
Discuss price confidently and ask directly for the sale.
Explore the real issue when a prospect hesitates.
Agree on clear decision dates and next steps.
Follow up actively by phone and email.
Keep accurate prospect notes, tasks and records.
Review your sales meetings and apply regular coaching.
Work towards individual sales targets.

About you




You will have:




C2 or native-speaker-level written and spoken English;
proven sales experience with personal responsibility for closing;
experience conducting sales meetings by phone or video;
confidence calling inbound leads;
experience using discovery questions to understand customer needs;
the ability to translate product features into commercial value;
confidence discussing price, handling objections and asking for a decision;
strong follow-up and organisational habits;
the ability to work independently in a fully remote environment;
a genuine interest in architecture, design, media or related creative industries;
the ability to work as an independent contractor while meeting the requirements of your local authorities.




Experience in SaaS, subscription sales, consultative sales, architecture, design, media or public relations will be highly regarded.




Because our prospects are based around the world, your English must be clear, natural and easy for international clients to understand. An accent is not a problem. Clear international communication is essential.


Our skateboarding culture




We like to skateboard. Not literally—that could end badly.




“Skateboarding” is how we describe daily improvement. Within the sales team, this means reviewing meetings, receiving specific coaching and applying one useful change at a time.




You will receive regular coaching and support, but you must genuinely enjoy being coached. We are looking for someone who can receive direct feedback, understand it and change their approach quickly.




This role will not suit someone who avoids phone calls, dislikes direct sales targets or does not want their sales meetings reviewed and coached.


What we offer




A fully remote position.
Pre-booked meetings with prospects who have already expressed interest.
Inbound leads rather than random cold-call lists.
A base payment plus attractive, uncapped commission.
Daily coaching and practical sales support.
The opportunity to work with architects, designers and media professionals worldwide.
A supportive global team.
BowerBird’s Grown-up Leave Program—our version of unlimited leave.
The opportunity to contribute to an Australian technology company working across architecture, design, media and AI.

How to apply




Please follow the link to apply, submit your CV, LinkedIn profile and a thoughtful response, explaining why you want to join BowerBird and why this role suits you.




Your response should help us understand who you are, how you sell and why BowerBird interests you. Generic cover letters or summaries of our website will not help us assess your fit.




Before reaching the interview stage, we recommend exploring BowerBird and listening to at least one episode of the BowerBird Architecture Podcast.




If you are an experienced salesperson who enjoys discovery, closing, phone calls, coaching and continuous improvement, we would like to hear from you.

description:
About the job

PoderJudicialVirtual.com | 100% remoto 




Resumen del rol

Buscamos al ingeniero que se sumará al equipo que va a construir el próximo producto de PoderJudicialVirtual de punta a punta y llevarlo a producción. Es un rol de constructor dentro de un equipo de desarrollo: entre todos toman la especificación, diseñan el backend en Laravel, construyen el frontend en Vue, integran los pagos con Stripe y lo lanzan a miles de usuarios reales. Con ownership real de tu parte del producto, sin capas intermedias y sin nadie revisándote el hombro.

No es un asiento más en una fábrica de software. Estamos ejecutando nuestro plan 2030: pasar de 2 productos en producción a 11 y expandirnos a Sudamérica. Tú construyes el primero de esa nueva ola, y quien construye bien aquí se convierte en pieza central de todo lo que sigue. El crecimiento se gana construyendo, no por antigüedad.

Te integrarás a un equipo de desarrollo en México, de la mano de un líder técnico fuerte, dueño de la arquitectura y la infraestructura, y de un Product Manager Senior que te entrega specs claras con Definition of Ready y Definition of Done. Tú eres dueño del código: de que escale, de que cobre bien y de que llegue a producción sin sorpresas.

Vas a trabajar sobre un dominio complejo (la infraestructura judicial mexicana) que tarda meses en dominarse. No esperamos que llegues sabiéndolo. Sí esperamos que en pocos meses tomes decisiones técnicas independientes y que tu código hable por ti.




Sobre nosotros

PoderJudicialVirtual es una empresa legaltech mexicana con más de 10 años en el mercado. Operamos la plataforma de datos judiciales más grande de México: más de 65 millones de registros de todo el país, con despachos, empresas y miles de personas usando y pagando el servicio todos los días. Somos rentables y no dependemos de inversionistas para ejecutar nuestro plan.




El proyecto

Arranque en septiembre de 2026. El equipo construirá un producto nuevo completo: backend en Laravel, frontend en Vue, flujo de referidos e integración de pagos con Stripe, desde la spec hasta producción. Al lanzarlo, sigue el próximo producto del plan. Aquí no se mantiene lo de otros: se construye lo propio.




Lo que buscamos




Requisitos:

• 5 años o más de experiencia profesional con PHP, idealmente Laravel.

• Capacidad real de leer, entender y mantener código existente con años de historia, no solo arrancar proyectos desde cero.

• MySQL a escala: has trabajado con tablas de millones de registros y sabes de índices y paginación eficiente.

• Vue.js sólido para trabajo full-stack.

• Diseño y consumo de APIs REST que escalan.

• Ownership: tomas un producto y lo llevas a producción. Detectas tus errores antes de entregar.

• Git con flujo profesional: manejo de branches, pull requests y participación activa en code reviews.

• Entorno de desarrollo Linux: configuración autónoma de stack local en Ubuntu (Apache, PHP, MySQL) sin dependencia de soporte externo.




Deseable (suma puntos, no descarta):

• MongoDB, 2 años o más.

• Automatización web: experiencia con Playwright, Puppeteer y gestión de proxies.

• Cloud: familiaridad con servicios de AWS.

• Inglés de lectura técnica: entender documentación, errores y recursos de desarrollo en inglés. No se requiere hablarlo.

• Experiencia integrando pasarelas de pago; Stripe en particular.




Sobre el uso de IA

Usamos IA todos los días y esperamos que tú también. La regla es simple: la IA amplifica tu criterio, no lo sustituye. Debes entender cada línea que mandas a producción. Durante el proceso vas a defender tu código en vivo, sin asistentes: explicar tus decisiones, encontrar errores en código ajeno y modificar comportamiento en tiempo real.




Soft skills (competencias clave que valoramos):

• Criterio técnico en revisión de código. Capacidad para identificar vulnerabilidades, cuellos de botella y errores de lógica, tanto en código propio como en el generado por IA.

• Ownership del resultado. Asumir plena responsabilidad sobre el código entregado. La IA es una herramienta; las decisiones y sus consecuencias son del desarrollador.

• Autonomía operativa. Capacidad para tomar un proyecto, definir el camino y ejecutarlo de principio a fin. Esperamos consultas estratégicas, no acompañamiento constante.

• Documentación de decisiones. Más allá del código, registrar el razonamiento detrás de las decisiones de arquitectura: el "por qué" que da contexto a futuras iteraciones del equipo.




Lo que ofrecemos

100% remoto.
Honorarios entre $65,000 y $80,000 brutos, acordes a tu experiencia.
Bono por objetivos ligado a que tu producto llegue a producción y cobre.
Impacto directo: lo que construyes lo usan miles de abogados y empresas desde el día uno.
Un plan 2030 real, con productos definidos y financiamiento propio, del que tu trabajo es pieza central.




Cómo aplicar

Envía tu CV junto con lo siguiente (las aplicaciones que no incluyan estos puntos no avanzan en el proceso):

Describe un sistema que hayas construido o mantenido tú y que esté (o haya estado) en producción: stack, escala de datos y usuarios, y cuál fue tu responsabilidad concreta.

title: Freelance AI Instructional Designer/ LED
description:
About the job

AI Learning Experience Designer

As an AI Learning Experience Designer (ID/LED), you will be responsible for designing and

contextualizing cutting-edge, instructor-led AI training programs for both technical and

non-technical audiences. You will collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs),

instructional designers, and product managers to create engaging, outcome-driven learning

experiences that help learners grasp, apply, and innovate with AI technologies.




Terms and Details:

● This is a flexible, contractor position on a per-project basis

● We would expect someone to provide at least 30 hours per week when on a project

● This role will be 100% remote




Key Responsibilities:

Discovery

● Work with leading LED or project managers to define key skills, competencies, learning

objectives and pathways within the discipline.

● Support sales teams or product teams in identifying client and learner needs and goals

and proposing learning solutions.




Design & Development

● Follow our client's design and development standards, best practices, and processes for

core and customized curriculum, materials, and assets.

● Design and develop AI-focused learning experiences that cater to learners at varying

levels of expertise and technical proficiency.

● Create instructor-led training materials (slides, hands-on labs, case studies, assessments)

aligned with best practices in AI education.

● Partner with AI subject matter experts (SMEs) to design practical, interactive exercises,

such as coding challenges, AI model-building workshops, and ethical AI decision-making

scenarios.

● Curate and contextualize existing AI content to align with emerging industry trends,

ensuring materials are always relevant and up to date.

● Design structured learning pathways for AI skills development, from foundational AI

literacy to advanced deep learning applications.

● Work with vendors, contractors and freelancers in content, assessment, and support

material production.




Delivery

● Develop instructor enablement materials to support live classroom training delivery (e.g.,

facilitator guides, learner workbooks, real-world case studies).

● Provide guidance to instructors on best practices for AI education, including effective

strategies for live coding demonstrations, interactive discussions, and problem-solving

activities.

● Work closely with instructors, learning facilitators, and client teams to tailor learning

programs for diverse audiences, including enterprise clients, startups, and government

organizations.

● Collect, synthesize and analyze data on learning impact for continuous improvement,

refinement, and content updating.

● Where applicable, work with translation vendors in the localization of content.

Productization

● Work with product management and learning teams to standardize patterns and

components for base curricular products.

● Work with product management and learning teams to build out the library of product

components, exemplars, and documentation.




Requirements:

● Has created content for an instructor-led program that focuses on AI concepts.

● Background in a client-facing role, either supporting or managing, is highly desirable

● Experience collaborating with AI subject matter experts to translate complex concepts into

structured, engaging learning experiences.

● 8+ years of instructional design or learning experience design with a focus on AI, data

science, or emerging technologies.

● Knowledge of instructional design methodologies, including Bloom’s Taxonomy, ADDIE,

and experiential learning models.

● Strong knowledge of AI concepts such as machine learning, large language models

(LLMs), neural networks, and ethical AI considerations.

● Thrives working in fast-paced, dynamic environments.

● Familiarity with Google Suite, and LMS content management and authoring tools.

● Willingness to flex your schedule to join meetings in different time zones, particularly in the

United States and Europe, Middle East, and Asia.




Nice to Have:

● Technical proficiency in AI and coding (Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar AI

frameworks). Including knowledge of GitHub.

● Familiarity with Virtual Machines (VM)

● Hands-on experience developing AI training labs, coding exercises, or real-world AI case

studies.

title: Lead Acquisition Specialist
description:
About the job

About AutoVanish

AutoVanish is an automotive broker operating in California, USA. We help people sell their car: the customer gets an instant online offer, and we manage the deal through our network of buyers — quote, negotiation, paperwork, and pickup logistics — until the seller gets paid. We're growing and looking for talent to join our Tijuana team.

Sobre AutoVanish

AutoVanish es un broker automotriz que opera en California, EE.UU. Ayudamos a las personas a vender su auto: el cliente recibe una oferta instantánea en línea y nosotros gestionamos la operación con nuestra red de compradores — cotización, negociación, papeleo y logística de la recogida — hasta que el vendedor recibe su pago. Estamos creciendo y buscamos talento para nuestro equipo en Tijuana.




¿Qué harás?

Nada de llamadas en frío. Trabajarás con clientes que ya nos contactaron pidiendo una cotización por su auto. Tu trabajo es cerrar el trato:

• Dar seguimiento por teléfono a leads que solicitaron una oferta en nuestro sitio web

• Explicar al cliente cómo funciona el proceso y resolver sus dudas (oferta, papeleo, título, entrega)

• Negociar y cerrar la operación entre el vendedor y el comprador

• Gestionar cada operación de principio a fin: coordinar papeleo, tiempos y logística de entrega con las partes involucradas

• Registrar tu actividad y dar seguimiento a tu cartera de leads en el sistema




Lo que buscamos:

• Experiencia comprobable en ventas (telefónicas, call center, automotriz o similar)

• Inglés conversacional avanzado — tus clientes están en Estados Unidos (indispensable)

• Actitud de cierre: te motivan las comisiones y los resultados

• Excelente comunicación, seguimiento y organización

• Disponibilidad para trabajar presencial en Tijuana

No necesitas licencia de conducir ni visa — todo el trabajo es desde nuestra oficina.




Ofrecemos:

• $15,000 MXN mensuales de base garantizada + comisiones sin tope por cada operación cerrada

• Horario fijo de lunes a viernes, 7:00 am a 3:00 pm — tus tardes son tuyas

• Sábados y domingos opcionales con pago extra, si tienes disponibilidad

• Leads calificados que ya quieren vender — no buscas clientes, los cierras

• Capacitación pagada desde el primer día

• Oportunidad de crecer con una empresa en expansión en EE.UU.




¿Te interesa? Postúlate con tu CV actualizado. Buscamos gente que quiera ganar bien y crecer rápido.What you'll do

No cold calling. You'll work with customers who already reached out asking for a quote on their car. Your job is to close the deal:

• Follow up by phone with leads who requested an offer on our website

• Walk customers through the process and answer their questions (offer, paperwork, title, delivery)

• Negotiate and close the deal between seller and buyer

• Manage each deal end to end: coordinate paperwork, timelines, and delivery logistics with all parties

• Track your pipeline and log activity in our system




What we're looking for

• Proven sales experience (phone sales, call center, automotive, or similar)

• Advanced conversational English — your customers are in the U.S. (required)

• A closer's mindset: commissions and results motivate you

• Strong communication, follow-up, and organization skills

• Available to work on-site in Tijuana

No driver's license or visa required — all work is done from our office.




What we offer

• $15,000 MXN guaranteed monthly base + uncapped commissions on every closed deal

• Fixed schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 am – 3:00 pm — your afternoons are yours

• Optional weekend shifts with extra pay, if you're available

• Qualified leads who already want to sell — you close, you don't hunt

• Paid training from day one

• Room to grow with a company expanding across the U.S.




Interested? Apply with your updated resume. We're looking for people who want to earn well and grow fast.Responsibilities

title: Software Engineer (AI Native)
description:
About the job

🎯 Misión del puesto: Nuestro equipo de ingeniería trabaja de forma AI-native: Los agentes de IA son parte del flujo de desarrollo de todos, no un experimento de unos pocos. Buscamos un(a) software engineer que construya y entregue features de producto operando agentes de IA como parte central de su forma de trabajar. No vas a construir sistemas de IA — vas a construir software (backend, frontend, integraciones) dirigiendo agentes con criterio, verificando su output y respondiendo por el resultado final como si lo hubieras escrito línea por línea. Este rol no es de prompt engineering ni de machine learning. Es ingeniería de software donde la IA es tu herramienta principal de trabajo, con todo lo que eso implica: saber qué delegar, qué no, y cómo comprobar que lo delegado está bien.




🛠️ Responsabilidades

• Entregar features end-to-end: descomponer el trabajo en tareas delegables a agentes y ejecutar directamente lo que requiere juicio humano

• Curar el contexto que los agentes consumen: documentación del repositorio, instrucciones reutilizables, contexto aislado por tarea

• Armar flujos multi-agente cuando el problema lo amerita — y reconocer cuándo no lo amerita

• Poner controles deterministas alrededor del trabajo agéntico: hooks, guardrails, gates de CI

• Verificar todo output de agente antes de que llegue a code review — con tests, no con confianza

• Empaquetar y compartir configuraciones y workflows que hagan más productivo al resto del equipo

• Documentar qué funciona y qué no, para que el aprendizaje sea colectivo




🔍 Experiencia y herramientas

• Inglés (Documentación, escritura, código).

• De 2 años en adelante de experiencia como Software Engineer con fundamentos sólidos. El criterio para detectar código plausible pero incorrecto viene de saber programar, no de saber promptear

• Uso real y demostrable de agentes de IA en tu flujo de trabajo diario. Cualquier herramienta (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, la que uses) — evaluamos criterio, no sintaxis de una herramienta específica

• Capacidad de explicar, sobre trabajo real tuyo: qué delegaste al agente, qué verificaste y por qué

• Testing como hábito no negociable: velocidad sin verificación no es velocidad, es deuda

• Experiencia con algún lenguaje de nuestro stack es un plus, no un requisito: Go, PHP, TypeScript/Node.js o React




📚 Plus

• Orquestación multi-agente, MCP, o tooling interno que hayas construido para flujos con IA

• Haber contribuido a la configuración compartida de un equipo (no solo tu setup personal)

• Experiencia en productos SaaS de alto volumen




🌟 Soft Skills

• Pensamiento crítico

• Descomposición de problemas

• Comunicación escrita

• Ownership del resultado

• Mentoring

title: Remediation Complaint Analyst
description:
About the job

Workstream: Post-Market Quality Assurance (PMQA) Remediation

Role: Remediation Complaint Analyst

Role Summary

The Remediation Complaint Analyst is part of the PMQA remediation team and supports the retrospective review of historical complaints. This includes assessment of complaints against the criteria prescribed by the applicable retrospective review protocol, documentation of results and escalation of issues identified.

Responsibilities

Perform retrospective review and assessment of intake and complaint records per applicable retrospective review protocols.

Assess complaints to confirm the applicable complaint failure mode has been assigned, and escalate where the event relates to a potential adverse event.

Confirm that complaint investigations are best in class and aligned with requirements.

Confirm that complaints have been closed in a timely manner.

Provide input to the post-market surveillance organization on information gathered from complaint investigations.

Document results in accordance with the applicable retrospective review protocol.

Escalate to remediation clinical specialists or product quality engineers for correction as required.

Support the retrospective review and process remediation team as needed.

Communicate issues to the respective retrospective review lead.

Complete all assigned work in a timely manner.

Support FDA CAPA and intermediate controls as required.

Complete assigned training prior to performing assigned job responsibilities.

Participate in team meetings.

Support team leads and project managers with communication and reports needed for other forums.

Support the PMQA organization and remediation efforts as needed to ensure compliance to regulations and standards.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or higher preferred, or an associate degree with five or more years of cradle-to-grave complaint handling experience.

Experience working in a medical device or pharmaceutical regulated environment.

Expertise in 21 CFR 820, 21 CFR 803, ISO 13485 and EU MDR.

Experience reviewing and assessing large quantities of complaints as part of a remediation project.

Experience with Microsoft Word, Excel and Teams, Agile, Salesforce or similar applications used in a medical device or pharmaceutical environment.

High level of attention to detail, with the ability to organize and manage multiple tasks.

Ability to spot consistent issues and escalate them to management, and to request feedback when unsure what action to take.

Good listening and communication skills, with the ability to stay on task and maintain timeline commitments.

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of regulations impacting radiological devices and other global regulations.

Reporting Structure

Reports to: PMQA Leadership



Desired Skills and Experience

ISO 13485, Complaint Handling

Drive alignment between central strategy and local operations.

Build intervention plans to unblock performance, reduce CPA, and accelerate output across all channels.

Strong business judgment and ability to prioritize with clarity and speed.

Ability to coach leaders, establish systems, and scale culture.

Deep understanding of offline go-to-market models, funnels, productivity, and incentives.
Hunter mindset with strong instinct for territory design, channel strategy, and execution discipline.

Obsessed with processes, consistency, efficiency, governance, and execution quality.

Experience leading large field organizations or multi-layer sales teams (50–200 people).

Nice-to-Haves


Experience in mobility, gig economy, logistics, FMCG, telecom, or other field-intensive industries.

What’s in It for You


Lead a high-visibility, high-impact regional growth engine.
Shape DiDi’s offline strategy and execution across multiple countries.
Opportunity to define the structure, systems, and culture of a rapidly scaling team.
Career acceleration with exposure to senior IBG leadership.



A chance to build something large, meaningful, and enduring.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The global ABP Team acts as a critical platform that enables and improves efficiencies and effectiveness across Stripe by providing high-value, high-impact administrative support to leadership. The global ABP Team is a recognized and valued team that is integral to how Stripe operates. A crucial part of the global ABP Team is our Administrative Coordinator team—a centralized group of highly motivated and skilled individuals who offer core administrative support to Stripe leaders.

What you’ll do

As the Administrative Coordinator program and team grow, you'll find ways to successfully build processes and systems for scale, manage hiring practices that maintain the Stripe talent bar, and manage individual contributors across multiple regions. Additionally, you'll build relationships with key stakeholders and leaders across the organization that enable and support the work of the Administrative Coordinators and the larger global ABP Team. You'll report to and partner closely with the ABP Program Manager and support operational efforts, programming, and processes for the global ABP Program, including operating cadence, rhythm of business, and documentation.

Responsibilities


Manage and lead a team of Administrative Coordinators
Maintain an understanding of team workload and bandwidth
Develop and maintain adherence to the scope of the program and ensure individuals are set up for success
Maintain an understanding of team and individual performance and quality of support
Develop and maintain program documentation and guidelines
Provide regular and frequent feedback and coaching to individual team members
Address program escalations, feedback, and concerns
Develop strong executive, peer, and stakeholder relationships, maintaining effective communication channels and influencing without authority
Manage the headcount and capacity planning process in partnership with the ABP Program Manager
Manage the onboarding and training (and associated logistics) for new Administrative Coordinators
Serve as an expert on Stripe- and ABP-related policies and guidelines (e.g., travel and expenses) and enforce with the team—provide guidance and expectations around administrative best practices, tools, and processes
Identify and solve large-scale, ambiguous, and complex problems with company- and org-wide impact and drive org-wide strategic improvements
Drive key changes to programs to achieve future-state objectives, including processes, documentation, measurement, etc.
Draft and distribute comms across the ABP Team and to key stakeholders
Ideate and implement process improvements for the global ABP Program
Drive efficiency through simplification, automation, and continuous improvement of systems, processes, and ways of working
Contribute to strategic planning and roadmapping for the global ABP Program
Support existing tools, processes, templates, playbooks, and knowledge management efforts
Exhibit excellent judgment on sensitive and cross-functional issues, building collaboration between leaders, sub-teams, and the larger organization



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


Experience managing stakeholders and influencing critical client relationships
Experience in headcount planning and hiring practices
Experience in project and program management
Experience as an Administrative or Executive Assistant or deep knowledge of the administrative support role



Preferred Qualifications


Experience managing or leading individuals or a small team
Experience in managing global programs
Experience mentoring, growing, and developing individual contributors
Experience managing bandwidth and balancing workloads of multiple individuals



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

title: SEO Manager (Digital Marketing Agency, EST Hours)
description:
About the job

SEO Manager (Digital Marketing Agency, EST Hours)




Pressure Washing Marketing Pros | Remote | Full-time, 9 AM to 5 PM EST




SNAPSHOT: $4,000 to $7,000 USD/month, depending on experience. Fully remote. 9 AM to 5 PM EST, hard requirement. You lead three SEO specialists, carry 10 to 15 of our hardest accounts yourself, and own SEO decisions day to day. Path to Head of SEO.




The apply link is at the bottom. Read the whole post first. We’ll know if you didn’t.




READ THIS FIRST




This role has two halves and you have to be good at both. You lead the SEO team, and you also run your own accounts. Most people can only do one of those.




Most SEO people who want to lead can no longer do the work. Most SEO people who can do the work do not want to lead. We have hired both. Neither one worked.




So if you want to work quietly on your own accounts and not manage anyone, this is not it. Close the tab. No hard feelings, those are good roles and we have hired them.




If you are strong at local SEO, you want to lead a team without giving up the hands-on work, and you want to grow into running a whole department, keep reading.




WHO WE ARE




We’re a digital marketing agency that works exclusively with exterior cleaning businesses (pressure washing, soft washing, window cleaning). We’re at $1.2M in revenue, 150 active clients, and client retention sits at 98 to 99%. Our clients love us, our results are real, and we built that by being obsessively good at one niche.




The SEO function here is not a startup. A team of specialists already executes consistently across 100+ local accounts, backed by a dedicated web and development team that handles the build work, and a client success team that owns the client relationships. The systems, the workflows, and the AI are already built in-house.




What the department does not have is a leader. Right now the founder approves every strategy, catches the problems, and makes the decisions. This role exists to change that.




THE ONE HARD REQUIREMENT




3+ years of hands-on local SEO at an agency, including at least one year with SEO people reporting to you.




Local. Read that again. Local or multi-location SEO for service businesses.




If your background is ecommerce, national, enterprise, or SaaS SEO, this is not a fit and we will not move forward. That is not a judgment on your skill. Enterprise and ecommerce SEO are genuinely hard. They are also a different job. Our world is Google Business Profiles, local pack rankings, service area and city pages, silo structure, citations, and keeping reviews coming in, across 100+ small local businesses in a single niche. A strong enterprise SEO would be starting over here, and would be bored inside a month.




We will not bend on the management year either. Leading three independent SEO specialists is a different skill from being the best specialist in the room. You need to have already had to look at someone else’s audit, decide it is not good enough, and tell them directly. If you have informally mentored people but have never been responsible for someone else’s work, this role will expose that fast.




THE SEAT, HONESTLY




You report directly to the founder. Three SEO specialists report to you. You are the final call on SEO decisions day to day.




You own your team’s standards and their output. You set the priorities, you give the feedback, you decide when work is not good enough, and you have those conversations yourself. The founder signs off on pay and hiring decisions, and he relies on your assessment of your team to make them.




You also carry your own book: 10 to 15 of our hardest accounts, hands-on. Our biggest clients, the accounts at risk, and the ones that just signed. That is on purpose. Your authority here is earned by doing the work, not handed to you with the title, and your specialists will know the difference inside a week.




Roughly how the week breaks down:




• 40% your own book of 10 to 15 accounts

• 25% reviewing the specialists’ work

• 20% leading the team: priorities, coaching, standups, hard conversations

• 10% digging into problems and recoveries across the full 100+ account book

• 5% client calls and strategy on our largest accounts




We are not promising you the Head of SEO role. We are telling you it is genuinely available to the right person, that it means owning the whole function across a larger book and a larger team as we grow, and that we would much rather promote into it than hire it from outside.




WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO




• Own SEO delivery across a 100+ account book. If work is late, wrong, or about to slip, you know before anyone tells you.




• Lead three SEO specialists: priorities, standards, coaching, and direct feedback when the work is not good enough.




• Run your own book of 10 to 15 of our hardest accounts, hands-on.




• Check the specialists’ work before it goes out: audits, on-page changes, content briefs and silos, Google Business Profiles, citations, internal linking.




• Figure out why rankings and local pack positions drop, and own the fix rather than the explanation.




• Approve monthly account strategies and make sure every account has a strategy and a report in the system on time.




• Look at the web team’s work for anything that will hurt SEO. They check their own build. You catch what will cost rankings.




• Work with our Ops and Delivery Manager on anything that crosses between teams, and talk to Client Success directly when an SEO account is in trouble. They hear it from you, not through a middleman.




• Keep the SEO processes and SOPs accurate and useful, and improve them once the system is yours. Documented and actually followed, not written once and forgotten.




• Get on client calls for our largest accounts and the ones in trouble, to defend the strategy and reset expectations. Roughly 10 to 15% of your time.




WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR




• 3+ years of hands-on local SEO at an agency, with at least one year managing SEO people. Non-negotiable, see above.




• Able to work 9 AM to 5 PM EST, Monday through Friday. Hard requirement.




• Real depth across on-page, off-page, technical, and local: Google Business Profiles, local packs, service area and city pages, silos, schema, internal linking, citations.




• Strong at figuring out what went wrong. Given an account that dropped, you come back with a real explanation of why, then prove it or rule it out. Not a guess, and not a generic checklist.




• You think in systems. When something goes wrong twice, you fix the process instead of the symptom, and you write it down so the next person does not have to work it out again.




• Vocal and proactive. You raise problems early, you propose the fix instead of waiting to be told, you say the uncomfortable thing in the meeting, and you push back on the founder when you think he is wrong. If you avoid conflict, this role will be miserable for you.




• Able to lead people who are used to being left alone. SEO specialists are independent by nature. You have to earn their respect with your work first, then actually direct them.




• Fluent in Ahrefs, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics.




• Strong with AI. We use it throughout the agency and expect you to use it to work faster and cleaner, not to think for you. Hands-on experience with Claude is a plus.




• Excellent written and spoken English. A lot of this job is written, and you are in front of our biggest clients some of the time.




• Comfortable in ClickUp, Slack, Loom, and Google Drive.




WHO WILL NOT SUCCEED HERE




Being honest because it saves us both time:




• The manager who can no longer do the work. You run good meetings and a clean board and you cannot audit a site yourself. We already know how that ends.




• The specialist who will not lead. You are excellent working on your own, and you go quiet when a decision or a hard conversation is yours to handle. That is half of this job.




• Ecommerce, national, or enterprise SEO backgrounds. See above.




• People who show up and start rewriting the system in week two.




• People whose strongest skill is interview polish or AI-assisted writing rather than live thinking.




• People who get defensive or go quiet when challenged directly. You will be challenged directly here, often.




• People who need a checklist for every task and reassurance every day.




If any of that is you, this role will make you miserable and you will not last. Please apply elsewhere. We genuinely wish you well.




TOOLS YOU’LL WORK WITH




• Ahrefs

• Google Search Console, Analytics, and Tag Manager

• Claude and our internal AI workflows

• ClickUp

• Slack and Loom

• Google Drive, Sheets, and Docs




COMPENSATION AND TERMS




• Pay: $4,000 to $7,000 USD/month, depending on experience and your ability to lead at a senior level without a long ramp-up period. The top of the range is for someone who can take over the department quickly. Your pay is based on the work you show us, not on what you ask for.




• Hours: Full-time, Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM EST. Hard requirement. This is a leadership seat, which means being available when your team, the other departments, and our clients are. 




• Location: Fully remote. We hire globally if you can reliably work 9 AM to 5 PM EST. 




• Tools and systems: We provide the tools, the automation, and our internal AI workflows.




• Path to more: Head of SEO as we scale, with the pay and ownership that comes with it.




HOW TO APPLY




We have a structured process, and it is built to reward people who can actually do the work rather than people who interview well.




We will not consider:




• AI-generated applications. We can tell, and we won’t move forward.

• Incomplete applications.




Apply only through this link:




https://hiring.pressurewashingmarketingpros.com/hiring/seo-manager/job-post-6643

por ello durante el proceso de atracción y selección no solicitaremos información personal, fotografías o análisis clínicos de ningún tipo. title: Head of Customer Operations
description:
About the job

Misión del puesto: Diseñar, ejecutar y evolucionar la operación de atención al cliente mediante la automatización inteligente de procesos, el desarrollo de equipos y la aplicación práctica de IA, transformando las funciones de Onboarding y Customer Support en una operación escalable, consultiva y orientada a resultados que maximice la retención, expansión y satisfacción de los clientes.




🛠️ Actividades principales

Transformación de Operaciones con IA

• Mapear y analizar los procesos de Onboarding y Customer Support para identificar oportunidades de automatización y escalabilidad.

• Diseñar, implementar y optimizar soluciones de IA que automaticen tareas repetitivas, consultas frecuentes, actualizaciones de estatus, procesos de onboarding e interacciones internas.

• Liderar la evolución del modelo operativo, definiendo qué actividades deben automatizarse y cuáles requieren intervención humana de alto valor.

• Medir y monitorear el impacto de las automatizaciones mediante indicadores como deflection rate, tiempo ahorrado, eficiencia operativa y redistribución de capacidad del equipo.

• Participar activamente en la construcción, configuración y mejora de automatizaciones, herramientas y flujos impulsados por IA.




Onboarding y Activación

• Liderar la estrategia de incorporación de nuevos clientes, asegurando una reducción continua del tiempo para generar valor (Time to Value).

• Diseñar experiencias de onboarding escalables, personalizadas y asistidas por IA para los distintos productos de Leadsales.

• Definir, monitorear y optimizar métricas de activación que impacten positivamente la adopción y retención de clientes.

• Garantizar una experiencia de implementación eficiente para soluciones como WhatsApp Business API, QR e integraciones de la plataforma.




Customer Support

• Liderar al equipo de Customer Support, asegurando el cumplimiento de SLA, estándares de calidad, CSAT y tiempos de resolución.

• Transformar el modelo de soporte tradicional hacia un enfoque consultivo y orientado a la resolución de problemas de negocio.

• Desarrollar las capacidades del equipo para identificar oportunidades de mejora, brindar recomendaciones estratégicas y acompañar a los clientes en la optimización de sus procesos comerciales.

• Convertir los hallazgos y necesidades de los clientes en retroalimentación estructurada para los equipos de Producto e Ingeniería.




Expansión

• Diseñar y consolidar la función de Customer Success mediante modelos de segmentación, health scores, playbooks y estrategias de seguimiento proactivo.

• Liderar iniciativas enfocadas en reducir churn, incrementar Net Revenue Retention (NRR) y fortalecer la adopción de la plataforma.

• Impulsar conversaciones de valor con clientes que permitan identificar oportunidades de expansión, upselling y crecimiento de cuentas.

• Asegurar que el equipo genere relaciones consultivas que contribuyan al éxito y crecimiento de los clientes.




Liderazgo

• Formar parte del equipo directivo y liderar las áreas de Revenue bajo la metodología EOS/Traction mediante Scorecards y reuniones L10.

• Gestionar el presupuesto, herramientas y recursos del área bajo una mentalidad de eficiencia, escalabilidad y apalancamiento tecnológico.

• Priorizar soluciones de automatización antes de considerar incrementos de headcount o nuevas contrataciones.

• Diseñar la evolución organizacional del área, definiendo nuevos roles, competencias, planes de desarrollo y rutas de carrera conforme las actividades transiten de operativas a consultivas.

• Liderar desde la ejecución, colaborando activamente con el equipo en implementaciones, automatizaciones, configuración de herramientas y contacto directo con clientes.




📚 Experiencia

• +6 años de experiencia en área de Operaciones, Soporte en una empresas SaaS B2B, idealmente atendiendo Pymes con alto volumen de clientes

• +3 años de experiencia transformando procesos, capacitando equipos y gestionando métricas clave del área




Nice to Have

- Experiencia en comercio conversacional, WhatsApp Business Platform o productos de mensajería.

- Experiencia construyendo AI APIs, automatizando sin código o creando agentes por tu cuenta.

- Experiencia con EOS/Traction o un marco similar.




🌟 Soft Skills

• Builder mindset

• Liderazgo transformacional

• Pensamiento estratégico

• Resolución de problemas complejos

• Orientación a resultados

• Adaptabilidad y aprendizaje continuo

About the job

Remote Customer Service & Client Relations Specialist




Join Our Team at APRINTCO

APRINTCO is looking for a high-energy, dependable Customer Service & Client Relations Specialist who enjoys helping customers, building relationships, and keeping projects organized.

This is not a passive customer service position. We are looking for a motivated team member who will actively connect with our existing customers, strengthen those relationships, and encourage clients to continue working with us.

You will also help process orders, communicate with our U.S.-based team, monitor production deadlines, and make sure every customer receives timely and professional service.

What You’ll Do
Make approximately 50 outbound calls per day to existing and previous customers.
Build stronger relationships with our client base.
Follow up with inactive customers and encourage them to place new orders.
Answer customer questions by phone and email.
Assist customers with product options, pricing, turnaround times, and order requirements.
Enter, update, and review customer orders accurately.
Coordinate with our customer service and production teams in the United States.
Track active orders and help ensure jobs are completed on schedule.
Communicate delays, artwork issues, or order changes clearly and professionally.
Follow up with customers after orders are completed.
Maintain accurate notes, customer records, and follow-up information.
Help resolve customer concerns while creating a positive experience.
Who We’re Looking For

Our ideal candidate is confident on the phone, highly organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Many of our projects are needed the same day or the next day, so strong communication and follow-through are essential.

You may be a great fit if you:

Speak and write fluent English.
Have excellent phone etiquette and professional communication skills.
Enjoy speaking with customers and developing long-term relationships.
Are comfortable making outbound customer follow-up calls.
Can confidently handle multiple orders and deadlines at the same time.
Remain calm, organized, and solution-focused under pressure.
Pay close attention to order details, instructions, and customer requests.
Take initiative without needing constant supervision.
Are dependable, punctual, and committed to following through.
Work well with a remote team.
Have basic computer skills and can quickly learn new order-management systems.

Previous experience in customer service, account management, sales support, printing, signage, or order processing is helpful but not required.




Position Requirements
Reliable high-speed internet connection
Quiet and professional remote workspace
Reliable computer and headset
Availability Monday through Friday
Ability to work during the company’s scheduled U.S. business hours
High school diploma or equivalent


About APRINTCO

APRINTCO is a wholesale sign and printing company with two locations in the United States. We specialize in supporting local print shops, sign companies, graphic designers, print brokers, and other trade customers.

Our products include banners, signs, adhesive vinyl, stickers, posters, display graphics, custom printed materials, and other large-format printing solutions.

We operate in a fast-paced industry where quality, accuracy, communication, and dependable turnaround times matter. Our team works closely together to help customers complete important projects—often under tight deadlines.




Why Join APRINTCO?

This position is an opportunity to become an important part of a growing company—not simply another person answering phones.

You will develop valuable experience in:

Customer relationship management
Client reactivation and retention
Order processing
Print production coordination
Problem-solving
Sales support
Working with a U.S.-based business team

We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company, take ownership of their responsibilities, and make a measurable difference in the experience we provide to our customers.

Ready to Apply?

Your customer service experience
Your experience making outbound calls

About the job

Karriere i Coop - Sammen skaper vi fremtidens varehandel Ledige stillingerBuilding the future of personalised customer experiences for 2.7 million members

Building the future of personalised customer experiences for 2.7 million members

Coop Digital & Technology

At Coop Norway, we are making a long-term investment in personalisation, not as a campaign tactic but as a core capability that will shape how our 2.7 million members experience Coop across channels, brands and moments that matter. 

We are building a dedicated, API-first personalisation platform on top of our cloud platform. Product teams will consume these services to power personalisation, marketing automation and loyalty, supported by a modern data platform and active experimentation.

As we scale the platform, we are also building the patterns and standards for decisioning and ML, so you can help shape how this is done. With more than 280 million yearly transactions, 60 million web sessions per year and 1,4 million weekly unique app users, this is an opportunity to build data-driven experiences at meaningful scale.

What We’re Building

A personalisation platform that teams can build on.

We are building a modern personalisation and loyalty platform that connects software engineering, data and customer insight, and turns that into reusable services on top of Coop’s cloud platform. These services are consumed by product and channel teams across app, web and eCom.

This Includes


A new foundation for marketing automation and loyalty, designed for scale and flexibility
Personalised offers (including coupons) and loyalty mechanics, with the data and science behind them
Strong governance around consent, privacy and trust
A platform that product teams (app, web, eCom) and specialist teams (retail media, content and adtech) can consume


This is not about dashboards or isolated experiments. It is about building capabilities and a platform that help teams make better decisions in the moment and deliver relevant experiences for millions of people, every single week.

WHY COOP IS DIFFERENT

Scale, data and a purpose beyond growth.

Coop is one of Norway’s largest membership-based organisations, with 2.7 million members and customers across grocery, non-food and DIY. This scale creates unique data, meaningful challenges to solve and strong real-world feedback loops, allowing you to see the impact of what you build in actual customer journeys.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique


A rich, real-world data foundation that is used daily across digital channels
The ability to see direct impact on customer experience and behaviour
A strong cooperative model, where value is created for members and not financial shareholders
Personalisation built on trust, transparency and responsible data use


It is a rare combination of scale, complexity and the opportunity to build capabilities that drive real customer journeys.

TECH STACK

At Coop, we work with a diverse technology stack. We do not expect you to know everything from day one; relevant experience combined with a willingness to learn will take you far.

Backend services: Golang services using gRPC with Protocol Buffers for service contracts, deployed on Kubernetes with infrastructure as code.

Data platform: BigQuery as our analytical warehouse, orchestrated with Dagster and modelled with dbt (running on GCP).

Experimentation: We use Firebase and Kameleoon for A/B testing.

Decisioning and ML: Vertex AI is part of our stack, and we are building patterns and standards for decisioning and ML as we scale the platform, so you can help shape how this is done.

Business tooling (first-class integrations): Hightouch, Braze and Talon.one, integrated as part of the overall platform so teams can activate audiences, journeys and offers reliably.

Architecture: Composable, API-first and built for reuse across app, web and eCom teams.

How We Work

Technology, data and business, working as one. You build it, you run it. You will work at the intersection of building reusable services and activation, creating capabilities consumed by app, web and eCom product teams, as well as specialist teams in retail media, content and adtech. Our cloud platform team provides the underlying developer experience, allowing you to focus on building services and products on top of that foundation.

You Will Work At The Intersection Of


Software engineering, data and analytics
Modern marketing and loyalty technology
App, web and eCom product teams, plus retail media, content and adtech


We Believe In


Cross-functional collaboration
Iterative development and learning
Clear ownership and real influence
Building things that last, rather than quick fixes


You will not inherit a finished solution. You will help shape both the platform and how we work with personalisation at Coop.

Who We’re Looking For

People who want to build, not just operate.

We are hiring across multiple disciplines. Whether your strengths are software engineering, data, analytics or marketing/loyalty tooling, we are looking for people who want to help build new capabilities from the ground up. We already have a dedicated cloud platform team enabling a strong developer experience. In this initiative, you will build reusable services and products on top of that foundation.

We Are Hiring For Roles Across


Software engineering: APIs and backend services, real-time systems, integrations, reliability/performance and secure runtime operations in a high-traffic environment.
Data engineering: data ingestion, modelling, data quality, pipelines (batch/streaming) and publishing reliable data products.
Data science & ML: model development and evaluation, feature engineering, MLOps, monitoring and retraining, applied to experimentation, decisioning and recommendations.
Data analytics / analytics engineering: KPI frameworks, effect measurement (uplift), experiment analysis, and turning insights into actions together with product teams and the business.
Marketing automation & loyalty tooling experts: hands-on implementation and integration of Braze, Hightouch and Talon.one.


We Are Looking For People Who


Are curious about how data and technology can create better customer experiences
Work effectively at the intersection of technology, data and business
Focus on outcomes and customer value, not only output
Want to help build a new platform capability from the ground up


You Might Have Domain Knowledge From


Recommendation engines, data, analytics or product-oriented roles
Technology platforms supporting customer engagement
Personalisation, CRM, marketing automation or loyalty


What matters most is how you think, and what you want to build.

OPEN ROLES

Join the team!

If this sounds like something you would like to be part of, we would be pleased to hear from you. We have several open roles across software engineering, marketing, and loyalty tooling already! Explore the positions below and see where you can help shape the future of personalization at Coop.

If you don’t see the exact role you are looking for yet, don’t worry – it may simply not be announced yet. We will be recruiting continuously, so feel free to follow along or connect with the recruiter to stay updated.
